description: Global Hubs ranks large freight forwarders, contract-logistics providers and brokers by reported gross revenue. Dmitry Golubnichiy publishes the table as CSV and Parquet with company, headquarters, fiscal year, revenue in local currency and US dollars, source URL and disclosed ocean or air volumes where available. The series has a public Zenodo concept DOI and CC0 metadata, so the release is free. A logistics modeller could use the company list and modal volumes as broad market context when building carrier or warehouse-operator scenarios. Gross revenue is not a physical capacity measure, and company fiscal years and currencies differ. The README states that source links lead to annual reports or filings, but this review did not inspect those filings or the data rows. Each row is an operator, not a site, route or time step; exact facility and corridor coverage is absent. Related Global Hubs datasets cover port, airport and rail operators as separate resources.
